svg.title: Known-best packing of 90 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=90 construction, never the source witness: Evan Daniel's regularizer's view of it, its contacts re-solved exactly at the record's side, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's. Regularized by the Squares Project with Evan Daniel's regularizer (evand/square-packing, MIT).

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 2026-11-15 exact rational centre-direction certificate at 90, read exactly from the retained source file n90/n90_exact.json at fa53fb0, in the watched repository JoostdeWinter/square-packing, which jlevy/squares#997 names in place of #996's 64d5ee7: a local-search improvement of T-303, jazivxt's packing of issue 989. Finite construction feasibility only; the linear program's first-order statement, local optimum, KKT, rigidity, same-packing, novelty, priority and global optimality are not replayed here.

svg.text: U n=90 regularized: side ~ 9.994038767 (certified upper bound)
